data.name: Twin Shot Knockdown
data.description: At 11th level, when the pistolero hits a single target with two or more onehanded firearm attacks during her turn, she can spend 1 grit point to knock the target prone. She can choose to spend the grit point after the attacks are made. This deed replaces the bleeding wound deed.
